notes: The audit compares evaluator-side Existing-Gold anchors with the frozen catalog source pages after runtime completion.
It does not expose Gold text to Parser, Retriever, Agent, Verifier, Prompt, or provider runtime.
English anchors cannot achieve exact-anchor coverage against the catalog-bound Chinese prospectus edition through ranking changes.
Four wrong-level and seven fact-without-risk units disagree with the frozen concentration thresholds when evaluated against the currently extracted clean percentages.
The 14 source-edition-mismatch cases are from the 2022 cohort; the 11 policy-disagreement units are from 2020-2021, so the lower-bound unreachable M1 sets are disjoint.
At least 25 of 102 M1 units are unreachable without changing immutable Gold, its source provenance, or the frozen policy, yielding an upper bound of 77 below the required numerator of 82.
No issuer, stock, page, or Gold-text special case is authorized as remediation.
